exposure: maternal circulating soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1 (sFlt-1)
cohort: The study included 87 post-date placentas from clinically healthy women with uncomplicated pregnancies and delivery outcomes.
finding: The majority of post-date placentas showed morphological signs of delayed maturation, and an increased pre-delivery circulating anti-angiogenic profile was associated with increased intervillous fibrin and syncytial knotting.
cross-section timing: Maternal serum sampled close to delivery; placentas assessed after delivery.
